# PCB Designer

> An open Agent Skill for PCB design, review, calculation, and fabrication
> release auditing.

Repository: https://github.com/SPREsxm/claude-pcb-designer
License: MIT
Version: 3.0.1

## Primary Files

- [Skill entrypoint](https://github.com/SPREsxm/claude-pcb-designer/blob/master/SKILL.md)
- [English README](https://github.com/SPREsxm/claude-pcb-designer/blob/master/README.md)
- [Chinese README](https://github.com/SPREsxm/claude-pcb-designer/blob/master/README.zh-CN.md)
- [Contributing](https://github.com/SPREsxm/claude-pcb-designer/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Changelog](https://github.com/SPREsxm/claude-pcb-designer/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md)

## Tools

- PCB planning calculator: `scripts/pcbcalc.py`
- Fabrication release auditor: `scripts/audit_release.py`
- Skill package validator: `scripts/validate_skill.py`
- Cross-agent installer: `scripts/install.py`

## Topics

PCB design, hardware engineering, embedded systems, schematic review, layout
review, DFM, EMC, signal integrity, power electronics, thermal design, EasyEDA,
嘉立创EDA, KiCad, Gerber, JLCPCB, AI agents, Codex skill, Claude skill.
